acceptance: When the Claude reviewer process exits non-zero and its standard output is a JSON envelope, either a single object or an event list with exactly one result event, that reports an error with a non-empty result, the raised launcher error keeps the existing process-failure wording and diagnostics location and additionally names the reported reason, bounded to its last 2000 characters.

When the Claude reviewer process exits non-zero with non-JSON output, an envelope without an error flag or reason, or an event list without exactly one result event, the raised error is exactly the existing plain process-failure message with the diagnostics location.

A non-zero reviewer exit always raises and never yields an answer, approval, retry or alternate engine; failures of the other engine keep their existing message, and the existing zero-exit error-envelope behavior is unchanged.

acceptance_tests.purpose: Run the launcher spec suite through a fake process runner to prove a non-zero error envelope surfaces its reported reason with the diagnostics location, that unreadable or reasonless output keeps the plain failure message, and that no answer is produced on failure.

selection.reason: A small deterministic diagnostic correction in the review launcher: a failed reviewer process discarded the reason its own output envelope already carried. The owning spec suite, run through its existing Node wrapper, gives a fail-before and pass-after reproduction without launching a model. No authentication, package, interaction or recurrence coverage is affected, so no wider category is selected.
